decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established postpress know-how and kept its own page in both years, so the firm can interpret results and refine it within its modular systems.

The folding add-on unit is close to the firm's core offer and has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, which the firm's application knowledge can build on, though its weaker web presence adds some risk.
